about_the_game:
Build the Perfect Team

Each party member has different abilities, synergies and choices in events

However, draft carefully: because without knowing how to scale your team to victory, you'll end up as a yummy snack for the bigger threats which lurk further within the woods...

Easy to Learn, Hard to Master

Simple mechanics combine into satisfying and deep game design, perfectly scratching that itch of watching numbers grow while your party powers up throughout their adventure.

Play At Your Own Pace

Runs can be as quick and snappy as you wish once you get used to the game (about 10 minutes long for veteran players), the game turn-based nature of the game also lets you choose to take your time and make the perfect decision—or read carefully and savor the writing.

Map Navigation

Prioritize the right tiles for your team's needs while watching out for the creeping fog, which affects each step you take throughout the randomized map...

Clever decision-making and capitalizing on opportunities can make (or break!) your run.

Demo Contents

The full game will include multiple themed sets of characters and events with their own unique mechanics and combinations, as well as maps, new challenges and more!

short_description: A roguelite where you gather allies and build the perfect team in a dangerous enchanted forest. Navigate events, fight enemies and dig through ruins while trying to avoid the creeping magical fog… Will your team endure… or be lost to the mist?
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Russian, Simplified Chinese
